narrative:
Marion County has 38,609 registered voters, with 15.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 52.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 26.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.0% of registrants.
